grid_convention: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical; row 0 = north edge, col 0 = 0°E

layers.name: Elevation (MOLA)

source.org: NASA GSFC / MGS MOLA Science Team; archived at PDS Geosciences Node (WUSTL)
source.product: MEGDR MEGT90N000EB (16 ppd median topography, v2.0)

layers.processing: 16 ppd MEGDR block-averaged 2x2 to 8 ppd. Source values otherwise unchanged.
layers.limitations: Cells near the equator are partly interpolated in the source (~55% of 16 ppd bins hold a shot). 7.4 km cells hide local relief.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Slope

source.org: NASA GSFC / MGS MOLA Science Team; archived at PDS Geosciences Node (WUSTL)
source.product: MEGDR MEGT90N000EB (16 ppd median topography, v2.0)

layers.processing: Central-difference gradient on the 16 ppd (~3.7 km) DEM with metric pixel spacing, maximum of the 2x2 block retained (conservative).
layers.limitations: A 3.7 km baseline strongly under-estimates metre-scale slopes; values >~5 deg already indicate rugged terrain. Not a rover-traverse safety product.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Terrain roughness

source.org: NASA GSFC / MGS MOLA Science Team; archived at PDS Geosciences Node (WUSTL)
source.product: MEGDR MEGT90N000EB (16 ppd median topography, v2.0)

layers.processing: Standard deviation of elevation in a 3x3 window at 16 ppd, averaged to 8 ppd.
layers.limitations: Kilometre-scale relief index only; boulder- and dune-scale roughness are not represented.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Crater density (≥1 km)

source.org: Robbins & Hynek (2012), Mars crater database 2020 release (user-supplied CSV)

layers.processing: Crater centres binned per 1° cell and divided by true spherical cell area.
layers.limitations: Uses crater centres only (no rim polygons). Density reflects surface age as well as hazard.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Thermal inertia (TES)

source.org: Arizona State University, Mars Space Flight Facility (MGS TES)

layers.processing: ASU numeric product is an 8-bit stretch (256 levels) clipped to 27-602 tiu; floor value 25 masked as polar no-data after latitude-band verification.
layers.limitations: Surface property, NOT temperature. Values above ~602 tiu are clipped in this product.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Albedo (TES Lambert)

source.org: Arizona State University, Mars Space Flight Facility (MGS TES)

layers.processing: 8-bit stretch (0.08-0.32) from ASU; floor 0.08 masked as no-data at the poles.
layers.limitations: Bright = dusty in most mid-latitude regions; polar frost contaminates high latitudes.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Dust cover index (TES)

source.org: Arizona State University, Mars Space Flight Facility (MGS TES)

layers.processing: Resampled by the ASU map server from 16 to 8 ppd; floor 0.85 masked as polar no-data.
layers.limitations: Lower values (<~0.94) indicate dust-mantled surfaces. Describes surface dust cover, not atmospheric dust or storms.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Rock abundance (TES)

source.org: Arizona State University, Mars Space Flight Facility (MGS TES)

layers.processing: Re-expressed on the shared grid; values unchanged.
layers.limitations: "Filled" product interpolates gaps. Rocks are >~0.1-0.15 m blocks inferred thermally.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: GCR dose rate (model)

source.org: Model in this platform, anchored to MSL RAD (Hassler et al. 2014) and the column-depth dependence of Guo et al. (2017)

layers.processing: column = P0·exp(-z/H)/g with P0=610 Pa, H=11.1 km, g=3.71 m/s²; dose = 0.21 mGy/day × (1 − k·(column − 22.9 g/cm²)), k = 0.015 per g/cm² (range 0.010-0.020).
layers.limitations: GCR only — excludes solar particle events (see SEP study in sources). Ignores seasonal pressure cycle, terrain shielding and solar modulation (±~30%). Valid only as a relative indicator.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Ice consistency 0-1 m (SWIM)

source.org: Mars Subsurface Water Ice Mapping (SWIM), Planetary Science Institute
source.product: SWIM4MIM Combined Ice Consistency Map (0-1 m), GeoTIFF
source.instrument: Composite: Odyssey neutron, thermal, geomorphology, SHARAD radar surface power

layers.processing: 20 ppd GeoTIFF block-averaged 5x5 to 4 ppd and shifted to 0-360°E.
layers.limitations: Consistency with ice is not confirmation of ice. Not mapped poleward of 60°.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Ice consistency 1-5 m (SWIM)

source.org: SWIM, Planetary Science Institute
source.product: SWIM4MIM Combined Ice Consistency Map (1-5 m)

layers.processing: As 0-1 m map.
layers.limitations: As 0-1 m map; radar dielectric inputs are sparse.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Ice consistency >5 m (SWIM)

source.org: SWIM, Planetary Science Institute
source.product: SWIM4MIM Combined Ice Consistency Map (>5 m)

layers.processing: As 0-1 m map.
layers.limitations: Deep geomorphology + radar only.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Water-equivalent hydrogen (GRS)

source.org: Univ. of Arizona / Mars Odyssey GRS team; PDS Geosciences Node

layers.processing: 5°x5° smoothed bins placed on a 0.2 ppd grid; 1σ uncertainty kept.
layers.limitations: Hydrogen may be bound in hydrated minerals — NOT direct evidence of ice. Footprint ~ hundreds of km.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

layers.name: Epithermal neutrons (Odyssey NS)

source.org: Los Alamos NL / Mars Odyssey NS; served by ASU MSFF

layers.processing: Values unchanged; −32768 masked.
layers.limitations: Indirect hydrogen proxy with ~600 km footprint; the grid is finer than the physical resolution.
layers.crs: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric lat, east-positive lon 0-360, simple cylindrical

source.org: USGS Astrogeology — Tanaka et al. (2014), Geologic Map of Mars, SIM 3292

layers.processing: Polygons rasterised at 8 ppd (point-in-polygon at cell centres, holes respected).
layers.limitations: 1:20,000,000 map: contacts accurate to tens of km. Unit ages from crater statistics.

unavailable.name: Atmospheric dust opacity / storms (MCS)
unavailable.reason: MCS retrievals are along-track vertical profiles (DDR/EDR). No gridded, time-resolved product could be retrieved and validated in this build; the 2018 storm is covered by the user-supplied papers only.

unavailable.name: SHARAD radargrams
unavailable.reason: Radargrams require per-track interpretation; integrated indirectly through the SWIM composite which uses SHARAD surface power and dielectric estimates.

unavailable.name: CRISM targeted observations / MTRDR
unavailable.reason: Footprint-level products are tens of GB; not retrievable here. TES global mineral abundances are used instead and labelled with their detection limits.

unavailable.name: Gridded surface temperature
unavailable.reason: No gridded temperature product integrated. Thermal inertia is a material property, not temperature. Survival module uses published RAD/REMS ranges.

unavailable.name: RAD RDR time series
unavailable.reason: PDS PPI RDR tables not retrieved; the radiation model is anchored to published RAD results instead.

unavailable.name: Soil engineering properties (cohesion, bearing capacity)
unavailable.reason: No global measured dataset exists. Values in reports are labelled as literature ranges from rover sites.

note: No synthetic data is used in this build.
